chars.SAAD: SAAD: a slim young Moroccan man about 24 with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a white hotel staff polo shirt with a small turquoise logo on the chest and beige chino trousers
chars.CLAIRE: CLAIRE: an elegant English woman in her late 40s with a blonde bob haircut and big gold hoop earrings, wearing a flowing coral-red summer dress
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a chubby young Moroccan man with a shaved head and a thick black beard, wearing a white hotel staff polo shirt with a small turquoise logo and black trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Marrakech hotel lobby with green zellige tiles and brass lanterns. CLAIRE leans across the reception counter very close to SAAD with a flirtatious smile; SAAD stands stiffly behind the counter, eyes wide, nervous and uneasy.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Sunny hotel breakfast terrace in Marrakech. CLAIRE sits alone at a table with coffee, staring intently at SAAD; SAAD carries a tray of mint tea and glances away, embarrassed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Hotel staff corridor. KARIM whispers into SAAD's ear with a teasing grin, both peeking around a doorway toward the pool outside; SAAD looks doubtful.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Riad hotel courtyard with a turquoise pool and palm trees. CLAIRE stands on an upstairs carved wooden balcony, looking down; below, SAAD arranges towels on sunbeds and looks up at her, surprised.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Poolside at the Marrakech hotel. CLAIRE laughs and touches SAAD's arm as they talk; SAAD smiles shyly, holding folded towels.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Hotel lobby in the evening. SAAD hesitates, rubbing the back of his neck, about to say something; CLAIRE waits in front of him with one eyebrow raised and arms crossed, amused.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Hotel entrance at dusk with the Marrakech skyline and Koutoubia minaret in the background. CLAIRE points outside toward the city, asking; SAAD shrugs with open palms, unsure.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Hotel reception at dusk. SAAD thinks with a finger on his chin, then explains something; CLAIRE listens with a sly knowing smile.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Hotel entrance at night under warm lanterns. CLAIRE takes SAAD's hand and pulls him gently toward the street, inviting him; SAAD freezes, shocked, glancing back at the hotel.
